test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The given bar graph shows the sale of toys (in thousands) from five branches of a manufacturer for two consecutive years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/916baaec2a1ec7fcb6df473284bff1d9d2e73c3d5e783bac079520caca07b231.png] 

What is the difference between the average sales (in thousands) of all the five branches in 2021 and 2022?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average Sales = dfrac{{Sum of Sales}}{{Number of Branches}}

**Calculations:**

Sum of sales in 2021 = 75 + 80 + 70 + 90 + 88 = 403

Average sales in 2021 = dfrac{403}{5} = 80.6

Sum of sales in 2022 = 85 + 90 + 110 + 95 + 110 = 490

Average sales in 2022 = dfrac{490}{5} = 98

Difference in average sales = 98 - 80.6 = 17.4

**∴ The difference between the average sales in 2021 and 2022 is 17.4 thousand.**
